flow: ui-path (ChatDriver) — composer insertText + Enter, streamed answer

steps.note: blank-compose view; conversation is auto-created on first send (POST /chat/conversation, body {model,preprompt,mlAssistant}); optional session snapshot injected (data/huggingface.co/.session)
navigate to base URL OR invoke sidebar New Chat (unverified aria-label); jittered 600-1300ms human dwell
Enter (keyEnter strategy; form submit handler), 50-200ms gate

rpc: underlying wire = POST /chat/conversation/{id} multipart form-data -> NDJSON chunked stream (event types: status started|error|finished|keepAlive, stream{token}, finalAnswer{text,interrupted}, title, tool, file{sha,mime,name}, reasoning, routerMetadata{route,model}, elicitation, plan{steps}, budget{totalMicroUsd,spentMicroUsd,reservedMicroUsd}, turnState{serverNow}); the UI path drives the site's own JS so no wire reconstruction needed for the ui-drive, but the send body/event shape is pinned below

wire.events: one JSON object per line (split on \n); %-varies: stream{token} deltas; terminal = status:finished or finalAnswer
wire.resume: GET https://huggingface.co/chat/conversation/{id}/stream?messageId={mid}&fromSeq={seq}  (EventSource; 'update' event = one event-object, 'end' event = close)

wireVerified: all endpoints and event union verified in bundles (chunks/D_6jIJz0.js Qw/vp/pp + Ar/Pa enums; nodes/4/5); live payloads verified via SSR data-sveltekit-fetched (models/settings/feature-flags)
stealth: real session, trusted inputs, site's own send handler — indistinguishable from the user typing
